import type { ReactNode } from 'react' import { cx } from '~/lib/cx' import styles from './invoice.module.scss' export type InvoiceStatus = 'draft' | 'due' | 'paid' | 'overdue' export interface InvoiceParty { name: string lines?: string[] } export interface InvoiceLine { description: string quantity: number unitPrice: number } export interface InvoiceProps { number: string status?: InvoiceStatus issuedAt: string dueAt: string from: InvoiceParty to: InvoiceParty items: InvoiceLine[] currency?: string locale?: string taxRate?: number notes?: ReactNode className?: string } const STATUS_CLASS: Record = { draft: '', due: styles.statusDue, paid: styles.statusPaid, overdue: styles.statusDue, } /** Printable invoice with parties, line items and totals. */ export function Invoice({ number, status = 'due', issuedAt, dueAt, from, to, items, currency = 'USD', locale, taxRate = 0, notes, className, }: InvoiceProps) { const format = (value: number) => { try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2, }).format(value) } catch { return `${currency} ${value.toFixed(2)}` } } const subtotal = items.reduce( (total, item) => total + item.quantity * item.unitPrice, 0, ) const tax = subtotal * (taxRate / 100) return (
Invoice

{number}

{status}
From

{from.name}

{from.lines?.map((line) => (

{line}

))}
Bill to

{to.name}

{to.lines?.map((line) => (

{line}

))}
{items.map((item, index) => ( ))}
Description Qty Unit Amount
{item.description} {item.quantity} {format(item.unitPrice)} {format(item.quantity * item.unitPrice)}

Issued {issuedAt}

Due {dueAt}

{notes ?

{notes}

: null}
Subtotal
{format(subtotal)}
{taxRate > 0 ? (
Tax ({taxRate}%)
{format(tax)}
) : null}
Total
{format(subtotal + tax)}
) }
